result:
This bounded correction is complete.

**v9-S1 is closed, and the finding was correct.** `relation_annotation_closure` iterated only fields that already carried `x-opensip-digest`, so an unannotated governed field was invisible by construction — and the check I wrote, named `every-relation-payload-digest-and-path-field-is-annotated-and-joined`, asserted a property it never tested. I took remedy (a): implement the missing limb and consume it in Run closure, and make the check test its claim. `relation-payload-schemas.v2.json` is byte-identical to frozen v9 — the law already declared all three limbs; only the consumer was missing.

**Root's three executed counterexamples found real defects in my draft traversal, and none of them was caught by my own control matrix:** a `$ref` to a container `$def` was never descended; two disjoint `oneOf` branches collapsed onto one path key so branch *order* decided admissibility; and an annotation on an intermediate alias `$def` was not seen, refusing a lawfully annotated field. All three are fixed and root's probes re-run green — control admits, every defect vector refuses, order makes no difference, both lawful annotation locations admit.

**One boundary I added and flagged rather than buried:** an annotation on the *terminal* governed `$def` (`DigestHex` itself) still refuses, since inheriting it would blanket-cover every field of that form in every relation. If root reads the rule differently it is one line, and it is asserted in-suite and in the probe either way.

Evidence, not assertion:
- **Neutralisation**: with enforcement, 0/39 injections admitted and the suite assertion False; neutralised, 39/39 admitted and the assertion True — the reviewer's finding reproduced on demand.
- **The reviewer's own p03/p04**, re-run: 39/39 limb-3 injections refuse; two p03 cases flip from admitted to refused.
- **No identity churn**, measured across frozen v9 and the corrected tree: every RunId, PlanId, payload digest, `bodyIdentity` and language-version component identical, with exactly two files differing.

Checks: identity **639/639** (602 at frozen v9), foundation 231/231, array-orders 65/65, product-config 28/28, product-quality 24/24, workflows 1290/1290, native 151/151 and security 456/456 (disposable copy), integration **363/363 with the builder unedited**. No in-tree report or pin was regenerated — reports, pins, `integration-fixtures.py` and the relation document are all byte-identical to frozen v9.

Two things worth your attention:

- One p03 case (`join-names-field-selector-lacks`) still doesn't reach `RELATION_JOIN_FIELD_UNKNOWN`. It behaves **identically on frozen v9 and here** — it renames a join role, which un-joins `contentSha256`, so limb 1 fires first. The reviewer documented that themselves and isolated it correctly in p04 case A. I did not reorder limbs to make someone else's probe report differently.
- `integration-fixtures.py:2` embeds `d07cfe7f…`, now stale; the new value is `3d3a1b708217827d059638ea42284a0df5bc7efd6dff40e4ce96a1d578631df0`. Root owns that refresh.

Owned files: `identity-model.py` `77ff7d02d73cc5798d6786d0e3eaec42dacd2aa34ece9ddd994a79bf03a8b79e`, `check-identity.py` `3d3a1b708217827d059638ea42284a0df5bc7efd6dff40e4ce96a1d578631df0`. Handoff, interface note and all probes (including one superseded result and one discarded adaptation, both labelled) are under `/tmp/opensip-design-corrections/digest-corrections-author.v7`, 416K with no repository tree copied.

This is a validator-consistency fix over hypothetical schema edits — not an admitted Run attack — and I claim no runtime security property and no product qualification. New freeze, fresh independent review at zero unresolved MUST/SHOULD, a new blind, and the complete application/readiness reconciliation all remain required.
